text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Did Brian bring another stone like this 
again?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Grains of earth build a mountain. This too 
is an achievement. 
Tomorrow, there will surely be more 
to add to this box.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Because this is Narita Brian's "job," 
after all.

text_block_list.name: Facility Caretaker
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much, Madam Vice President! 
We really appreciate you going out of your 
way 
to haul this cargo from Tracen Academy!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Then I shall head back to the academy.

text_block_list.name: Facility Caretaker
text_block_list.text:
Ah, do you have a quick minute? 
There's a spot I'd love to recommend 
for next year's Summer Walk.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
(...Student council work is a pain. 
It just eats up useless amounts of time.)

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
I'm so sorry, Vice President～! 
I dropped my keychain somewhere around 
here...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Save the chatter. 
We find it before sundown.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
(Nothing but tedious tasks rained down on 
me. 
...Is listening to whiners considered part 
of the job too?)

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... Scatter, you crows...! 
Get lost...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Stopping by the fields, I spotted Narita 
Brian 
wrestling with a murder of crows. By the 
looks of it, 
she was trying to drive them away, but...
choice_data_list: U-Um... I'll help you out!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Ah, hey...! 
Don't go riling them—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (CAWWWW!!)
choice_data_list: UWAAAAH!?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Man, you really saved us, Brian! 
And you too, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to you, we could fix up the field 
netting. 
Those crows were always getting in the 
way.
choice_data_list: Ahaha, glad I could be of some help...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
You weren't. You just got attacked by 
crows 
and gave me more work to deal with.
choice_data_list:
Thanks for saving me back there, by the 
way...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Tch, that's it for today's work. 
...You, move aside.
choice_data_list: ...? Ah, sure.
...? Oh, right.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Then, Narita Brian picked up a single crow 
feather 
that had fallen on the ground.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: —This feather should suffice.
choice_data_list:
A feather... Are you going to use it for 
something?

A feather... What are you going to use it 
for?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
The student council is a troublesome 
organization.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
If I don't submit a "report" for every 
single thing, 
Air Groove never shuts up.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! Air Groove's lightning temper 
is terrifying, after all～!
choice_data_list: That feather is your... report...?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: That's right.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
For instance, if I had a job in the 
forest, 
I'd just pick up a twig or an acorn from 
the site.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Hand over something you can only obtain by 
being there. 
That is proof that I did the work.
choice_data_list:
(Whoa... She sounds so completely 
confident about this.)

(Wow... She sounds so completely confident 
about this.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It certainly seems to make a kind of 
sense, but 
would a report in that format actually 
pass muster?
choice_data_list: ...Want me to help you write the report?
...Want me to help you write the report?

The student council is surprisingly 
flexible, huh?

The student council is surprisingly 
flexible, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That might make some sense, but... 
is that format really acceptable for a 
report?
choice_data_list: ...Want me to help you write the report?
...Want me to help you write the report?

The student council is surprisingly 
flexible, huh?

The student council is surprisingly 
flexible, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Don't.
choice_data_list: Why not?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
If I write one properly, what happens when 
they start demanding a report every single 
time?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Are you saying you'll write them 
in my place every time?
choice_data_list: ...Well, that might be a bit much...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I don't need unnecessary meddling. 
This is plenty.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Later on, I heard that Narita Brian 
had left a crow feather, a twig, and an 
acorn 
on the student council room desk.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
It's not flexible. 
If anything, it just causes endless 
headaches.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...Besides, neither Rudolf nor Air Groove 
are the type to ever lessen the workload.
choice_data_list: ...Sounds tough.
...Sounds pretty rough.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Hmph.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
If you get it, don't make extra work for 
me. 
You hear me? ...I'm not bailing you out 
again.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Later on, I heard that Narita Brian 
had left a crow feather, a twig, and an 
acorn 
on the student council room desk.
